sources.title: Quantum Calabi-Yau and classical crystals

evidence.text: Diagonal slicing turns a 3d partition into an interlacing sequence of ordinary partitions. A complex-fermion Fock-space representation and bosonized Γ± transfer operators evaluate the weighted partition sum; their commutation factors recover the MacMahon product.

sources.title: Spectral networks

evidence.text: Construct walls as ij-trajectories satisfying Im(e^(−iϑ)ẇ^(ij))=0. Grow a mass-truncated network from three walls at each simple branch point; intersections generate descendants with soliton indices fixed by joint rules. A descendant enters the cutoff only at the sum of its parents’ masses.

evidence.text: Reduce the infinite problem to an inhomogeneous linear system in one parent unit cell. Twisted boundary conditions satisfy b(E_i,r+Δr)=b(E_i,r)+Δr·c(E_i). Geometric identities remove the b variables from consistency conditions and constrain C charges.

sources.title: The Effective action of D7-branes in N = 1 Calabi-Yau orientifolds

evidence.text: Reduce democratic type IIB supergravity together with Abelian DBI and Chern–Simons actions. Keep RR fields and their duals until brane couplings are included, then eliminate redundant tensors and magnetic vectors through a Lagrange-multiplier dualization with sources.

sources.title: Calabi-Yau fourfolds for M theory and F theory compactifications

evidence.text: Use Landau-Ginzburg state counting, Newton/reflexive polyhedra and dual-face lattice counts for topology; toric fans and triangulations for divisors and transitions; Weierstrass models and Kodaira/Tate analysis for fibre degenerations.

sources.title: De Sitter vacua from a D-term generated racetrack potential in hypersurface Calabi-Yau compactifications

evidence.text: Use reflexive-polytope triangulations, combinatorial divisor Hodge numbers, intersection-ring linear algebra and Kähler-cone tests in Sage; then scan quantized D7 fluxes and B-fields subject to Freed–Witten and D3-tadpole constraints.

sources.title: D-instanton, threshold corrections, and topological string

evidence.text: The proposed evaluation route uses open topological strings and holomorphic anomaly equations, with Chern–Simons theory or matrix-model techniques where applicable. Explicit compactification examples remain a stated next step.

sources.title: On NS5-brane instantons and volume stabilization

evidence.text: Can an Euclidean NS5-brane wrapping the entire Calabi–Yau contribute directly to overall-volume stabilization or uplift, and how can its corrections be represented in N = 2 supergravity and an orientifold-inspired N = 1 truncation?

sources.title: On TCS G$_{2}$ manifolds and 4D emergent strings

evidence.text: An orientifold limit provides a conditional dictionary between G2 cycles and Calabi-Yau parity sectors, permitting tests of which wrapped-brane arguments survive the quotient.

sources.title: D3/D7 Branes at Singularities: Constraints from Global Embedding and Moduli Stabilisation

evidence.text: How can local models of fractional D3-branes and flavour D7-branes at del Pezzo singularities be embedded consistently in compact Type-IIB Calabi-Yau orientifolds, while retaining a tractable moduli-stabilization analysis?

sources.title: The Octagon and the Non-Supersymmetric String Landscape

evidence.text: Can fractional D3-branes at an orientifolded toric Calabi–Yau singularity engineer a fully stable dynamical supersymmetry-breaking vacuum, avoiding the known instability caused by N = 2 fractional branes?

sources.title: Orientifolds of K3 and Calabi-Yau manifolds with intersecting D-branes

evidence.text: Can intersecting-brane orientifolds be extended beyond toroidal backgrounds to K3 and Calabi–Yau threefolds, with chiral spectra and consistency conditions determined geometrically rather than through explicit partition functions?

sources.title: F-Theory and the Landscape of Intersecting D7-Branes

evidence.text: How do elliptic Calabi–Yau deformations encode D7-brane positions and shapes, which orientifold intersections obstruct their motion, and how can this correspondence guide flux stabilization?
